label: D2 after a2->S2 (common) following a rewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and essentially only when the observed inputs are action a2 and state S2 (a common a2->S2 transition) and the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward == 1); all variables are observed at D2. It is also restricted to the first ~40 trials of the episode (none after trial ~50; peak at trials 10-29) and is enriched in episodes that start with S2 good (89% of mass) and at high model value (top value bin holds >99% of mass). The predicate catches ~99.7% of activations and mass but only about a third of matching steps are active (dev F1 0.50); adding start_high, good, prev_action or a value threshold did not raise F1 meaningfully (best about 0.55 with ep_trial 3-34), so the remaining gating looks like slow hidden-state context, not any single variable. Never fires at D1 or GO, after a1 or at S1 (fewer than 10 steps), after a rare transition, or after an unrewarded trial. Magnitude: in example windows it is largest on the first of a run of rewarded a2->S2c trials and decays over consecutive repeats (e.g. 0.66, 0.49, 0.41, 0.37, 0.34); this comes from the examples only and was not tested systematically.
